narrative: Inventory optimization analysis for material PL1__M89B2A4B reveals a moderate demand pattern with CV=0.425 and unstable lead time (CV=0.400). The optimized policy recommends a safety stock of 192 units (vs SAP 318) and order quantity of 2215 units, yielding annual cost savings of $60.09 (5.4%). Storage capacity constraint is binding, limiting order quantity from unconstrained 4204 to 2215 units. Recommended safety lead time is 2.06 days vs SAP 6.0 days. Dominant lead time variance factor is transport (40%).
warnings: High lead time variability (CV=0.400) - consider supplier performance review
Moderate-to-high demand variability (CV=0.425) - forecast accuracy important

research_insights.selected_model: EOQ with stochastic lead time and capacity constraints
research_insights.selection_rationale: EOQ model chosen due to moderate demand (CV=0.425). Safety stock calculated using standard deviation of demand during lead time (sigma_ltd) accounting for both demand and lead time variability. Storage capacity constraint is active, capping order quantity at available space.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Capacity-constrained order quantity (2215) is 47.3% below unconstrained EOQ (4204), increasing ordering frequency and cost. Lead time variability (CV=0.400) is unstable, requiring 192 units of safety stock.
